# Alongside Digital - Presenter

> Beautiful Worship. Effortless Control.

Presenter is a modern, lightweight presentation software designed to keep your focus on what matters. Seamlessly manage songs, bibles, liturgy, media, and more.

## Core Features
- Songs: Add your own custom songs or seamlessly import from Song Select. Organise and build your repertoire.
- Images & Presentations: Use presentation slides natively as images, or upload PDFs to display content perfectly on screen.
- Bible Integration: Instantly add bible chapters and verses directly from YouVersion, or use your own local offline Bibles.
- Liturgy Management: Add and manage liturgy dynamically. Assign colours to easily indicate who should be speaking.
- Videos: Add local videos, YouTube, Vimeo, and other web videos directly into your presentation flow.
- Local Music: Add your local music collection to play walk-in music, backing tracks, or ambient soundscapes.
